title: sepiabox-ingest report --json, v1
description: Unique photos and videos in process work folders, counted as the catalog counts them (S-062, D-074): one per content, an asset in several work folders once, with the date and kind the cloud's merge gives it. What the MVP acceptance (S-054) compares the answers with.

workFolders.description: The work folders read, as full paths, in the order given (upload order).

total.description: Every counted asset: the years' totals plus the undated.

years.description: One entry per year with at least one dated asset, in increasing order. The year of capturedAt as stored (wall clock, D-037).

multipleSources.description: Assets found at more than one path.

problems.description: Manifests that failed validation and are not counted; the command then exits with 1.
